recentItems.title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight – Mayhem Collection DLC Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
The Mayhem Collection DLC, included in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Deluxe Edition, releases September 18, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order today: https://ninten.do/6007aPnmb 

Who's ready to become Gotham City's Most Wanted? 

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is a brand-new, open world action-adventure that invites players to embark on Bruce Wayne’s epic journey to become the hero of Gotham City. It's inspired by decades of Batman films, television, comic books, and games, and jam-packed with Batman nostalgia, DC lore, and TT Games’ signature brand of fun-filled LEGO humor. 

#LEGOBatmanGame

recentItems.title: Minecraft Dungeons II – Gameplay Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:

Mysterious rifts are opening across the Overworld! They lead to the Sift, a new dimension coming in Minecraft Dungeons II. Gear up and team up to journey into uncharted lands and face threats unlike anything you've fought before. Discover new ways to customize your loadout and playstyle as you prepare for your toughest battle yet. Do you have what it takes to brave the Sift?

recentItems.title: Stellar Blade Complete Edition – Action Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Become humanity’s last hope in Stellar Blade Complete Edition, releasing on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026!  

You are EVE, an elite warrior sent to reclaim Earth from mysterious forces. Are you up to the challenge? 

This story-driven action-adventure features fast-paced combat built around dodging, parrying, and unleashing powerful combo attacks, alongside cinematic exploration and intense boss encounters. 

Experience EVE’s journey at home or on the go, and enjoy all-new Joy-Con 2 support for features such as fishing! 

#StellarBlade #CompleteEdition
